seo.title: Conversion Tracking - Trends Over Time
seo.description: Track conversion rates over time, spot trends, and break down by segments. Like funnels but built for monitoring how conversion changes. Good for A/B testing and growth.

hero.heading: Is conversion going up or down?
hero.subheading: See how your conversion rates change over days, weeks, and months. Break down by any property to compare variants or campaigns, and catch regressions early.

related_features.title: Funnels
related_features.description: See where users drop off step by step. Funnels show you which step loses users-conversions show you how rates trend over time.

related_features.title: Event tracking
related_features.description: Conversions are built on the events you track. Send events once and use them for conversions, funnels, retention, and more.

related_features.title: Retention
related_features.description: Conversion measures if users complete an action. Retention measures if they keep coming back.

related_features.title: Data visualization
related_features.description: Conversion charts are one of many ways to visualize your data in OpenPanel.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about conversion tracking in OpenPanel.

items.question: How is this different from funnels?
items.answer: Funnels show you a multi-step sequence and where users drop off at each step. Conversions focus on a single flow (start → goal) and show you how the conversion rate changes over time. Use funnels to diagnose where users get stuck; use conversions to monitor whether things are getting better or worse.

items.question: Can I use conversions for A/B testing?
items.answer: You can break the report down by your experiment variant property and compare the lines, period by period, with the totals and per-period counts in the table. There is no statistical significance test; OpenPanel shows the rates and the counts, and you decide.

items.question: What events can I use?
items.answer: Any two events you already track. A conversion report is exactly two events, a start and a goal, each with optional filters. Common pairs are session_start → sign_up, sign_up → purchase, or screen_view (path is /pricing) → started_trial.

items.question: Is the data sampled?
items.answer: No. OpenPanel processes every event with no sampling. Your conversion rates are calculated from complete data, so you can trust the numbers even for small segments.

items.question: Can I see absolute numbers alongside rates?
items.answer: Yes. Every conversion report shows both the conversion rate and the total number of conversions. The detail table below the chart includes totals and per-period counts for each segment.

items.question: What are the settings?
items.answer: "Funnel Group" (session or profile), "Funnel Window" in hours (default 24), "Y axis" fixed at 0–100% or auto, and "Compare to previous period". The interval can be minute, hour, day, week or month.
